facts.fact: Oberlo statistics, cited by Grubhub, state that 90.8% of all online queries go through Google.
facts.quote: after all, [90.8% of all online queries](https://www.oberlo.com/statistics/search-engine-market-share) go through this search engine.

facts.fact: Grubhub's article says Google measures searches based on five key factors: meaning, relevance, quality, usability, and context.
facts.quote: Google measures searches based on [five key factors](https://www.google.com/search/howsearchworks/how-search-works/ranking-results/):

facts.fact: Grubhub's article is titled '10 pro tips to boost your restaurant's SEO' and presents 10 tips to improve restaurant SEO.
facts.quote: ## **10 tips to improve your restaurant SEO**

facts.fact: Google switched to mobile-first indexing in late 2020, meaning it evaluates the mobile version of websites when determining search rankings.
facts.quote: In late 2020, Google switched to [mobile-first indexing](https://developers.google.com/search/blog/2020/03/announcing-mobile-first-indexing-for). In other words, the search engine looks at the mobile versions of websites

facts.fact: According to the RestaurantEngine source cited by the page, more than 80% of consumers look for restaurants using their smartphones.
facts.quote: more than 80% of consumers [look for restaurants](https://restaurantengine.com/how-many-customers-use-mobile-devices-to-find-restaurants/) using their smartphones.

facts.fact: Grubhub recommends that restaurants include as much information as possible in their Google Business Profile, including an address, phone number, website URL, operating hours, and photos.
facts.quote: Make sure to include as much information as possible, including an address, phone number, website URL, operating hours, and photos.

facts.fact: Schema markup can be used to identify a restaurant's address, hours of operation, menu, cuisine type, star rating, price range, and service area.
facts.quote: You can use schema to identify your restaurant’s: Address Hours of operation Menu Cuisine type Star rating Price range Service area

facts.fact: Google switched to mobile-first indexing, so the page states that optimizing a website for mobile devices can help it appear higher in local search results.
facts.quote: Optimizing your website for mobile devices can help you appear higher in the local search engine results.
